sources.snippet: MTX abundance changes are highly affected by underlying differences in metagenomic abundances (i.e. gene copy number). This package can adjust the DNA abundance as a continuous covariate for a given feature in the models for differential expression analysis in microbial communities.

It integrates feature-specific covariates to determine multivariable association between metadata and microbial MTX features.
